tools.name: coalesce_generate
tools.description: Runs Coalesce code generation to regenerate web project *.g.* files from existing data project files.

tools.name: get_template_features
tools.description: Get the files for a specific Coalesce template feature, or list all available features if no feature is specified

feature.description: The name of the template feature to get files for. If not provided, lists all available features.

tools.name: read_template_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from the Coalesce project template. Call with no arguments to list all available template files.

filePath.description: Path or partial filename to match within the template (e.g. 'package.json', 'Web/vite.config.ts', 'Data.csproj'). Case-insensitive. If multiple files match, all matches are listed. Omit to list all available files.

tools.name: read_changelog
tools.description: Read the Coalesce changelog. Optionally filter to only show entries for versions newer than a specified version.

sinceVersion.description: If provided, only return changelog entries for versions newer than this version (e.g. '6.0.0'). The entry for the specified version itself is excluded.
